svg.title: Languedoc-Roussillon study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Languedoc; 2: Roussillon; 3: Montpeyroux; 4: Pézenas; 5: Saint-Georges-d'Orques; 6: Saint-Chinian; 7: La Livinière; 8: Boutenac; 9: Fitou; 10: Limoux; 11: Nîmes

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
